clips.title: The story
paras: Darkspear trolls make their home in the Valley of Spirits, west of Orgrimmar's main thoroughfares. Thatched lodges, tiki poles, and pools mark their place among the city's red stone and iron.

The Valley of Spirits branches west from the Valley of Strength, a quiet enclave for the Darkspear trolls. The tribe settled in Durotar alongside Thrall's orcs, and made this pocket among the crags their gathering place in the city. Trollish craftspeople, spiritualists, and practitioners gather around wooden bridges and winding waters, practicing their arts away from the dry heat of Orgrimmar's main thoroughfares.

The valley's lodges and pools draw those who practice magic and wild crafts. Witch doctors, herbalists, and spellcasters gather at the Spirit Lodge and Darkbriar Lodge. At the back, the Talon Gate opens toward the Barrens' open plains, giving wanderers, hunters, and travelers a quick passage beyond the canyon walls.
